reason: Three registered and dispatched tools implement GTM account, container and tag inspection through the Google Tag Manager v2 client.
exposure: All three tools are unconditionally advertised and dispatched. createGA4ConfigTag is an internal helper with no public registration or dispatch; version management is only a future README promise.
limitations: Static extraction of the literal tools/list array; authenticated GTM execution was not tested.
List methods do not paginate; list_tags chooses the first workspace without user selection.
Handlers return API errors as ordinary content error objects rather than MCP isError responses.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.behavior: Lists GTM accounts through tagmanager.accounts.list and returns account data; API errors are returned as error objects.

tools.name: list_containers
tools.behavior: Lists GTM containers under the supplied account path and returns container data; API errors are returned as error objects.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.behavior: Selects the first workspace of the supplied GTM container, lists its tags and triggers, and returns tag names, types, IDs, parameters and resolved firing-trigger names.

review.summary: Lists accounts and containers and resolves firing-trigger names for tags in the first workspace.
review.reason: Three registered and dispatched tools implement GTM account, container and tag inspection through the Google Tag Manager v2 client.
